analysis_en.detailed_summary: The flow creates your own copy of an existing app. Using that copy and modifying it with Conjure are presented as alternatives.
analysis_en.search_intent: To understand how copying a Discord app relates to customizing it with Conjure.
analysis_en.source_context: October 31 records bot server-membership requirements, personal and server projects, and app copying with Conjure.
analysis_en.summary: This copy offers an app copy for immediate use or customization with Conjure.
analysis_en.what_it_means: The copied app can be used immediately or customized further.
analysis_en.when_it_appears: When an existing app is offered as a starting point for your own copy.
